legalPages.title: Terms & Conditions
legalPages.text:
Introduction:

By accessing the Site, you confirm your understanding & accepting of the Terms and Conditions, which includes all the details below, If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions of use, please do not access, register with or use this Site.

The Site reserves the right, to change, modify, add, or remove portions of these Terms and Conditions of use at any time, Changes will be effective when posted on the Site with no other notice provided Please check these Terms and Conditions of use regularly for updates. Your continued use of the Site following the posting of changes to these Terms and Conditions of use constitutes your acceptance of those changes if you do not agree to the changes in the Terms of Use as they occur, you should exit and not use the Web Site.

Use of the Website:

  • Membership of the website is not available to persons under the age of 18 years and Sadko has the right to cancel the account of any member who has not yet reached the age of 18 year.
  • When you register as a member of the Site you have been or will be required to provide certain information and register a username and password for use on this Site and you will provide true, accurate, current and complete information about yourself, and you will not include any of your contact details including but not limited to email addresses, telephone numbers or other personal details.
  • You will be responsible for maintaining your account secret information and your password confidentiality, and so you agree to inform Sadko immediately of any unauthorized of your password or login to your account, or any other breach of confidentiality of your information.
  • Sadko is committed to deal with your personal information and contact details confidentially.
  • You must comply with all applicable laws to regulate trade via the Internet.

Trademarks and Copyrights:

All intellectual property rights, whether registered or unregistered, in the Site, information content on the Site and all the website design, including, but not limited to, text, graphics, software, photos, video, music, sound, and their selection and arrangement, and all software compilations, underlying source code and software shall remain our property. The entire contents of the Site also are protected by copyright as a collective work under Egyptian copyright laws and international conventions. All rights are reserved.

Sadko Commitments:

  • It is the sole and exclusive owner by law of the beneficiary by all materials of any kind that it wants to offer for sale on the website, and it has the evidences proving that it has the right and authority to trade in these materials and to offer them for sale.
  • It will comply with all local and international laws applicable in this regard, as well as applicable laws and regulations regarding the use of the website.
  • The information and description of goods in order to be published on the website are true, accurate, detailed and illustrated the sale.
  • To operate according to the website policy concerning the maintenance of the privacy of contact and communication Information, and it will not disclose the details of information and contact addresses, including phone numbers, mailing addresses, and e-mail addresses, anywhere on the website, including the models and Forum, and Item details, or through any e-mail features of the website.

The confidentiality of information:

  • Sadko shall abide by the standards for the protection against the arrival of an unauthorized person to your personal identity information, and saving them. Knowing that the Internet is not a secure way, the confidentiality of your personal information cannot be guaranteed 100%.
  • Sadko has no control over the actions of any third party, like other Internet pages linked to this website, or any third parties claiming to represent you or to represent others.

Termination:

We may suspend or terminate your use of the Web Site at any time, for any reason or for no reason. We reserve the right to change, suspend, or discontinue all or any aspect of the Web Site at any time without notice. Additionally, we may cancel any order placed through the Web Site at any time in our sole.

legalPages.title: Shipping & Payment Info
legalPages.text:
Shipping and delivery is handled by Sadko crew staff to ensure maximum goods care and quality standard services.

Delivery is to Cairo , Giza & Alexandria only is a free of charge service offered by Sadko.

Delivery to North Coast is available during summer season only. This service is subject to delivery charges which will be notified by our customer service staff.

Payment methods are cash on delivery ( COD ) andcredit card.

legalPages.title: Return Policy
legalPages.text:
We accept the return of an item only if it is in an unopened, original box and/or packaging intact with all labels on it.

Sealed & Closed Box means: A brand-new, unused, unopened, undamaged item in its original packaging. Packaging should be the same as it was delivered to you.

  • Cases where it is difficult for us to support returns:
  1. Return request is made outside the specified time frame of 14 days from delivery.
  2. Product is used, damaged, or is not in the same condition as you received it.
  3. Defective product which is covered under the manufacturer's warranty.
  4. Item which has been used or installed.
  5. Anything missing from the package you have received including, original packing, freebies and accessories.
  6. Items classified as non home appliances such as books , handcrafts & games
